subject: Request: short trial keepalive after demo schedule shift
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.p@brightfieldlabs.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Grove <ethan.grove@brightfieldlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo and trial timeline — integration hit

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Quick update from our side: our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the CRM connector — an upstream API change means we need to refactor the auth flow and re-run a subset of integration tests. Our engineers estimate ~10 business days to finish, which pushes the demo and evaluation window out.

We want to keep the pilot alive (the proof-of-concept is critical for our Q4 roadmap), but we won't be able to run the scheduled demo on Oct 4. Can Redwood extend the trial and/or apply a small credit to cover the extra days while we sort the connector? A short extension (2–4 weeks) or a modest sandbox credit would help keep momentum.

Also: would it be possible to reschedule the customer-facing demo to the week of Oct 18? We can commit to the revised timeline if we have assurance the sandbox and API quota won't lapse.

Apologies for the disruption — we appreciate any runway you can provide.

Best,
Maya
Maya Patel
Product Manager, Brightfield Labs
maya.p@brightfieldlabs.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.p@brightfieldlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo and trial timeline — integration hit

Maya — thanks for the heads up and for the clear timeline. Sorry to hear about the connector change; we see this pattern often when third-party providers iterate.

We can absolutely keep the pilot active while Brightfield finishes the integration. Proposed options:
- 30‑day trial extension from your current expiration date; OR
- 20k token sandbox credit applied to your project + 14 day extension if you prefer a smaller time bump.

If you want the full 30 days, we can apply that immediately against deal BF-2026-0917 and update the HubSpot record. If you prefer the credit route, we can provision it within 24 hours and share sandbox access notes.

To move quickly, could you confirm: (1) which option you'd like, (2) your new preferred demo week (I saw Oct 18 — works for us but confirm day/time), and (3) any network/whitelist IPs our SRE team should pre-authorize?

I'm attaching a short mutual action plan template so we capture milestones and the demo date. Marissa, looping you in for operational help on sandbox access and quota. David, this will need the sandbox ACL change we discussed last quarter — can you confirm ETA if we proceed with credit provisioning?

Thanks — we want to ensure Brightfield has a seamless handoff back to engineering without losing momentum.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: MAP_template.xlsx
From: Maya Patel <maya.p@brightfieldlabs.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Grove <ethan.grove@brightfieldlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo and trial timeline — integration hit

On Mon, Sep 27, 2026 at 10:04 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Maya — thanks for the heads up and for the clear timeline.
> 
> We can absolutely keep the pilot active while Brightfield finishes the integration. Proposed options:
> - 30‑day trial extension from your current expiration date; OR
> - 20k token sandbox credit applied to your project + 14 day extension if you prefer a smaller time bump.

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the quick reply and the clear options. Brightfield engineering prefers the credit route (the token buffer will let us sanity test without extending our internal schedule). To confirm: we accept the 20k token sandbox credit and the 14 day extension.

Demo reschedule: Oct 19 (Tue), 11am PT would work for our team — Ethan will be our technical lead on the call.

Whitelist/IPs: we'll send an allowlist for the staging network by end of day tomorrow.

Can you confirm the credit allocation and any steps Ethan should expect to get sandbox access? Also — do you need a short purchase order or approval doc from our procurement team, or can Redwoods apply the credit now under the existing PO in the HubSpot deal?

Thanks again — we'll aim to close the connector fix this coming Friday (10/8) and will keep you posted.

Best,
Maya
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.p@brightfieldlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo and trial timeline — integration hit

Maya — great, thanks for the confirmation.

We have approved the 20,000-token sandbox credit and applied a 14‑day extension to your pilot (deal BF-2026-0917). Action items we've taken:
- Credit applied and visible in your project quota (you'll see a note in the console under Billing > Credits).
- Sandbox ACL request opened — David is provisioning the temporary access for Ethan and the staging IPs once you send the allowlist.
- Demo tentatively booked for Oct 19, 11am PT (calendar invite to follow once Ethan confirms).

Procurement: no new PO required — we applied the credit against the existing deal. If Brightfield needs a formal approval note for your internal records, I attached a short approval text file you can forward to procurement.

Attachments included: sandbox-access-instructions.pdf, trial-credit-approval.txt (simple approval note you can share internally).

David — can you confirm you have the ACL ticket and ETA for provisioning once the allowlist drops in? Marissa — please send the MAP template back with the milestone dates plugged in after Maya/Ethan confirm the demo agenda.

Thanks everyone — we'll stay on the thread for any follow-ups.

— Lauren
